name: Projected Terminal Image Preview Card
description: Shows a bounded, noninteractive preview for a validated local raster image while its terminal path remains the current fine-pointer hover target.

states: Inspect the preview below a path in the upper half of the terminal and confirm its restrained overlay treatment.
Inspect above-path placement, inline-edge clamping, and long-filename elision near the lower-right terminal edge.

useWhen: A Desktop-local projected terminal attachment has validated a supported raster image under the current fine-pointer path hover.
avoidWhen: The attachment is Browser Preview, archived, coarse-pointer, or lacks explicit local filesystem-effect authority.
invariants: Only the latest full hover membership may publish visible content; leaving, replacement, geometry or revision change, cancellation, recovery, freeze, and disposal retire it.
The card is pointer-transparent and accessibility-hidden, so terminal selection, application mouse reporting, keyboard input, and semantic path opening retain ownership.
The terminal package never reads the filesystem; Desktop Main validates a regular file, an 8 MiB bound, extension, and magic bytes before returning ephemeral content.
Preview failure is silent, bytes are neither persisted nor cached, and Browser Preview attachments never receive a local-file capability.
